statement.p: Find dy/dx in terms of x and y if \arctan(x^{2} y) = x y^{2}.

static.solution: x. \frac{1}{(1 + x^{4} y^2)} (2 x y + x^{2} \frac{dy}{dx}) = y^{2} + 2 x y \frac{dy}{dx}, so, clearing the denominator, 2 x y + x^{2} \frac{dy}{dx} = (1 + x^{4} y^2) (y^{2} + 2 x y \frac{dy}{dx}). Thus ( x^{2} - (2 x y) (1 + x^{4} y^2) ) \frac{dy}{dx} = y^{2} (1 + x^{4} y^2) - 2 x y, and finally \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^{2} (1 + x^{4} y^2) - 2 x y}{x^{2} - (2 x y) (1 + x^{4} y^2)}.
